description: An input belongs to the domain of a partial function exactly when some output appears with it in the graph.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.domain_iff {n : ℕ}
  (f : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction n)
  (x : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args n) :
  x ∈ Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.domain f ↔
    ∃ a, (x, a) ∈ Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.graph f
